scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix frontend && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:api" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
